<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-05-2103-23-13" status="unreviewed">yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4264">gnyags</rs> na re sgra shing rtag par khas len pa la sgra byas pa'i phyir rtag par thal lo ||
         thal ba las kyang mi rtag par 'gyur te khyab pa ma grub bo <lb n="346.1"/> zhes rang rgyud 'phen no zhes zer ba yang 
         ma yin te thal 'gyur de rang rgyud kyi phyogs chos dran byed kyi yan lag kyang ma yin la khyab pa dran byed kyi yan lag du'ang mi rung bas so ||</seg></TEI>
